source_precedence: owner-approved Move R3 for shared style
NIN-002 V3 as historical reference; preserve all 84 legacy cels
older P3 clips are candidates, not blanket approved

move.label: Run
move.semantic: Single running loop for all combat movement. Keep existing move asset key; no separate walk, sprint or transition clips.

hard: no fabricated mirrored or interpolated frames
same model reference hash for all actions
qa.warning_note: Proposed review triggers at runtime size, calibrated against six approved Move R3 strips; not automatic identity proof. Attack, hit and fall require pose-aware anchors; do not force bbox height equal.
qa.policy: One automated pack check and one quick combined GIF review at actual game size. Advisory minor defects do not block. One runtime smoke per batch after pilot. No repeated image generation for cosmetic differences or nominal cell overflow. Cache and reuse approved sources.

presentation.scope: Presentation only for V4 kits. Never change simulation, movement, targeting, or existing V3 directional art. Verify in pilot.

processing.source_layout: Use wider native cells/gutters for fall and extended poses. Nominal grid overflow is not a failure if the full sprite can be isolated.
repair_order: Recover full sprite from original alpha using row-aware variable crop bounds
Recenter and repad without cropping visible anatomy
If wider than runtime canvas, use proportional downscale only as needed with stable root; retain native original; no anisotropic stretch
Regenerate affected row only if image pixels are genuinely absent, inseparable or visibly unusable
processing.retry_budget: Default zero extra image calls for correctable defects. At most one targeted retry for unrecoverable blockers, then HOLD specific clip and continue batch.
processing.current_sakura: Reuse all existing source atlases including current Move if visually usable; recover Fall from original before any rerender.
